drivers.name: THE BRAND EGO
summaryFields: Who buys or makes the purchase decision?
Who actually uses or receives the product/service?
Who showed interest but did not convert?
What does the audience see, hear, do and publicly express?
What do they privately think, want or fear?
How do they want to see themselves through the brand?
What pain, fear or risk should the brand reduce?
What rational or social gain do they seek?
What emotional meaning can the brand own?
What proof is needed to trust?

tools.name: The Dog Matrix
tools.prompt: Separate purchaser, user, ideal audience and lost opportunity.

tools.name: The Feel Map
tools.prompt: Map public/external behavior and private/internal motivations.

tools.name: Brand Desire Canvas
tools.prompt: Map desired self-image, friend/enemy comparison and social meaning.

tools.name: Attitudinal Journey
tools.prompt: Map attitudes to novelty/trust and the proof, feeling and experience each profile needs.

tools.name: The Brand Ego
tools.prompt: Synthesize pains, gains, self-interest and deeper emotional meaning.

drivers.name: THE BRAND GANG
summaryFields: What is simply expected in the category?
What does the market value beyond the minimum?
What can this brand uniquely own?
What conceptual territory should the brand occupy?
Indirect players changing habits or rules
Which brands outside the category reveal useful patterns?

tools.name: The Max Pyramid
tools.prompt: Separate category minimums, valued differentiators and singular strengths.

tools.name: The Brand Territory
tools.prompt: Map the competitive territory from functional/rational to emotional/meaning-led.

tools.name: ABC Roll Axis
tools.prompt: Map consumer role and brand role on aspirational/democratic and facilitator/inspirational axes.

tools.name: Revolution Matrix
tools.prompt: Map historic, current-star and rule-changing competitors.

tools.name: The 5 Friends
tools.prompt: Collect cross-category references and extract transferable innovation patterns.

drivers.name: THE BRAND ESSENCE
summaryFields: What positive change does it motivate?
What broader change does it elevate?

tools.name: Los 5 Qués del Branding
tools.prompt: Clarify what the brand evangelizes, defends, motivates, elevates and contributes.

tools.name: The Core Value
tools.prompt: Reduce the value proposition to a simple, memorable core idea.

tools.name: Brand Positioning Model
tools.prompt: Define what the brand is, how it delivers and why it matters.

tools.name: Purpose Check
tools.prompt: Test whether purpose is genuine, coherent and activated through actions.

tools.name: Brand Values
tools.prompt: Define values as active behaviors rather than isolated adjectives.

tools.name: The Brand Symbol
tools.prompt: Define ideals, associations, symbols and repeatable rituals.

tools.name: Brand Charisma Archetypes
tools.prompt: Choose and justify the personality/archetype that best expresses the brand.

tools.name: Tone of Voice Path
tools.prompt: Define tone, voice territory, style rules, differential resources and key/forbidden words.

tools.name: Full Brand Board
tools.prompt: Define a coherent visual world: symbol, type, color, photo, illustration, layout, motion and related assets.

tools.name: The Sense Square
tools.prompt: Define distinctive sensory cues, especially sonic and tactile/visual qualities.

subtools.name: Tagline / Slogan
subtools.prompt: Separate enduring brand line from campaign-level line.

drivers.name: THE BRAND EXPERIENCE
summaryFields: Why is this brand the best option?
What action should be easy to take?

tools.name: Why We?
tools.prompt: Clarify problem, best-option reason and call to action.

tools.name: Brand Narratives
tools.prompt: Define internal/external narratives, sagas, proof points and actions.

tools.name: Brand Rituals
tools.prompt: Define repeatable IN/DURING/OUT rituals, direct or ambient.

tools.name: The 10 Golden Moments
tools.prompt: Map critical journey moments from awareness through recommendation.

tools.name: The Burn Pyramid
tools.prompt: Identify experiences that move from basic competence toward memorable, representative and shareable impact.
